items.text: – Nin yahow, aad baad u caajis tahay. Goormaan waxan oo kale idhi?
items.q: Someone teases him for acting like a baby. Is 'caajis' the right word?
before: …waday: – Runtii ma fahmi karo waxa aad iga jeclaatay. Isku-soo-ururinta sunaha indhahayga? Dirirtayda? Mise sida aan ula sheekaysto qof kasta adiga mooyaane? Ma jirtaa wax ka murugo badan inaad fadhiisato oo aad i daawato anigoo dadka kale oo dhan, gaar ahaan qofkaas gaarka ah, la sheekaysanaya?
– Aad bay ii murugaysaa, laakiin habeen iyo maalin lama qaylin karo dadka Ilaah. Ma tago oo Siinaa la diriraa?

items.text: Adiguna, habkaas gus-ka ah ee aad u hadasho awgiis, magacaagu wuxuu ahaan lahaa Alain Guslon.
items.q: 'Alain Guslon' is meant as a rude pun on the actor Alain Delon. Would Somali readers get it? If not, what word could carry it?
before: – Haa, Haamuun magac fiican baa kuu ah. Sida Haamuun-ka filimka, adiguna su'aalo baad ka buuxdaa. Walaac baad ka buuxdaa, waxaadna tahay il welwel, ma aha naftaada, laakiin aniga.

items.q: Her son says he would die for her; Maman objects. An old Persian proverb kept word for word: can you guess its meaning?

items.text: Gacantaydu way gaaban tahay, midowgaaguna wuu fog yahay.
items.q: Amir tells the girl he loves why he holds back. A Persian expression kept word for word: can you guess its meaning?

items.text: Murug ha cunin, wiilkayga caqliga badan.
items.q: Maman comforts her little boy, whose feet are hurt. A Persian expression kept word for word: can you guess its meaning?

items.text: Bibi, Ilaahay ha u naxariisto, xiliyada sidaas ah waxay dhihi jirtay: haddaan dhaho, carrabkaygu ayaa guban; haddaan dhihin, laf-gashkaygaa guban.
items.q: Maman hesitates before criticising her husband. An old Persian proverb kept word for word: can you guess its meaning?

items.text: – Ka dibna ka fikir waxa Baaba aan jacaylka ah uu soo marayo – guriga oo dhan joogay sannadahaan oo dhan.
items.q: Is it clear poor Baba has sat idle at home all these years?
before: …waxa keliya ee ay lahayd waxay ahayd inay fadhiisato dhammaadka luuqa. Waxay tidhi: qalbigaygu wuu qudhmayaa. Anigu ugu yaraan tolidda ayaan xoogaa isku mashquuliyaa, xataa marka carruurtu maqan yihiin. Shaqadu way wanaagsan tahay, Amiir. Markaan shaqo la'aan ahay, marnaba uma adkaysan karo.
Qaasim ayaa yiri, isagoo qosol adkayn:

items.q: Maman quotes a lonely friend who has nothing to do all day. A Persian saying kept word for word: can you guess its meaning?

items.text: Guriga Daawuud ayaan arkay. Duntu gacantayda bay ku jirtay.
items.q: A small boy holds a thread to find his way. Is 'Duntu' right?
before: …oo wixii cadaa madaxayga ka jiiday, banaankana igu riixay. Haddana waan sii socday. Meeshii aan hore ugu dhacay, gacantayda ayaan ishayda saaray. Si qarsoodi ah ayaan farahayga dhexdooda uga eegay. Hadda haddii aan tago, gacantayda indhahayga ma saarayo. Baaskiil ma jirin. Haddana waan sii socday.
